questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) A computing process can be reduced to three main stages.

(i) Name each stage and describe the processes carried out at the stage. (4 marks)

(ii) Illustrate these processes in a labeled diagram, indicating the direction of the flow of data or information. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) The three stages (4 marks).**

- **Input (1.5 marks):** data and instructions are entered into the computer through input devices (keyboard, mouse, scanner, microphone...) and converted into binary form.
- **Processing (1.5 marks):** the CPU carries out the instructions on the data (calculating, comparing, sorting, updating), using the memory to hold the programs and data in use.
- **Output (1 mark):** the results are presented as information in a form that people can use, on a screen, on paper or as sound (monitor, printer, speakers).

(The results and programs can also be kept on a storage device so that they can be used later.)

**(ii) Diagram (2 marks).** Data flows from input to processing, and information flows from processing to output; storage exchanges data with processing in both directions.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(b) A 2GB USB key contains 8 files with names and sizes as follows:

| Name | Size | Name | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| Naruto.wav | 20MB | Mbi-xls | 60MB |
| Gce.txt | 512KB | Wed.gif | 50MB |
| Microtech.tiff | 3MB | Mira.mpeg | 250MB |
| Techno.avi | 200MB | Deph.mp3 | 50MB |

(i) What is the likely classification of these files under the categories of **picture, sound, video** and **document files**. (4 marks)

(ii) Each filename has some characters after the dot. What is the name and significance of these characters? (2 marks)

(iii) What amount of space is free in the USB key? (4 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Classification (4 marks, 1 mark per category)**

| Category | Files |
|---|---|
| Picture | Microtech.tiff, Wed.gif |
| Sound | Naruto.wav, Deph.mp3 |
| Video | Techno.avi, Mira.mpeg |
| Document | Gce.txt (text), Mbi-xls (spreadsheet) |

**(ii) The characters after the dot (2 marks).** They are the **file extension**. It shows the type (format) of the file, so that the operating system knows which application can open it and how the data in the file is coded (for example .txt = plain text, .mp3 = compressed sound).

**(iii) Free space (4 marks).** Work in megabytes, with 1 GB = 1024 MB and 512 KB = 0.5 MB.

- Total used = 20 + 0.5 + 3 + 200 + 60 + 50 + 250 + 50 = 633.5 MB.
- Capacity = 2 GB = 2 * 1024 = 2048 MB.
- Free space = 2048 - 633.5 = **1414.5 MB**, which is about 1.38 GB (roughly 1.4 GB).

(With 1 GB = 1000 MB the answer is 2000 - 633.5 = 1366.5 MB; either convention is accepted if it is stated.)

Check by script: the sum of the sizes is 633.5 MB and 2048 - 633.5 = 1414.5 MB.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(c) As a security measure in a company, access at the workers' gate is granted after a fingerprint scan. A newly recruited worker was rejected entry by the system.

(i) What is the likely reason why the system rejected his entry request? (2 marks)

(ii) State one disadvantage and one advantage of automated data capture systems. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Likely reason (2 marks).** The new worker's fingerprint had not yet been recorded (enrolled) in the system's database, so the scan found no matching record. (A dirty, wet or injured finger, or a badly placed finger, can also give a failed match.)

**(ii) Automated data capture (2 marks).**

- **Advantage (1 mark):** it is fast and accurate; it removes the errors of typing data by hand and the data is available at once.
- **Disadvantage (1 mark):** the equipment is costly to buy and maintain, and a fault or a failed read (for example a valid worker refused) stops the work or needs a manual check.
